$comment: The Field Guide quiz's ladder (docs/trivia.md §5): questions mastered, per kid, across every hero. Each rung grants once and is never taken back. A title here must be a look in content/looks.json with unlock { "from": "trivia", "rung": <at> }. Owed art, not shipped until it is drawn: the tent decorations deco_quiz_bookmark (10), deco_quiz_lamp (80) and deco_quiz_bookshelf (175), the nameplate frames Scroll (50) and Gilded Scroll (220), and the special Inkglow (120). The 80 rung gives only a decoration, so it waits for its art and is left out until then. The first-try track gives badges only.

badge.name: Curious Reader
badge.blurb: Ten questions right. The Field Guide is starting to stick.

badge.name: Lore Hound
badge.blurb: Fifty questions right. You sniff out the answer every time.

badge.name: Sage of the Guide
badge.blurb: A hundred and twenty right! Grown-ups ask you about monsters now.

badge.name: Keeper of Every Page
badge.blurb: Two hundred and twenty right. You could have written the Field Guide.

badge.name: Sharp Memory
badge.blurb: Twenty-five right on the very first try.

badge.name: Never Forgets
badge.blurb: A hundred right on the first try. Nothing slips past you.
